description: This file defines the DisabledTransactionAgent class implementing the ITransactionAgent interface, providing stub methods that throw exceptions indicating transactions are disabled.

classes.name: DisabledTransactionAgent
classes.description: A class implementing ITransactionAgent that disables transaction operations by throwing exceptions.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Throws OrleansTransactionsDisabledException to indicate transaction abort is disabled.

methods.name: Resolve
methods.description: Throws OrleansTransactionsDisabledException to indicate transaction resolution is disabled.

methods.name: StartTransaction
methods.description: Throws OrleansStartTransactionFailedException indicating starting a transaction is disabled.
